name: Amakase Miharu
source: Miharu is [spoiler]an android patterned after[/spoiler] a childhood friend of the Asakura family [spoiler]with the same name, and is thus experiencing lots of things for the first time[/spoiler]. Her enthusiasm often overrules her common sense[spoiler], and Jun'ichi often has to get her out of sight when her circuits start to overload[/spoiler]. [spoiler]Like her namesake[/spoiler], she enjoys eating bananas. [spoiler]The real-life[/spoiler] Miharu adores [url=/c4012]Nemu[/url], and behaves much like a little puppy around her.
